body: Record the request as received before any verification or search. Keep the original wording.
sections.heading: Intake fields

body: Next steps: send acknowledgment, start identity verification, log dates in the request log. Do not search systems before identity is verified, except to confirm the account exists.
sections.heading: Immediate handling

body: Subject: Response to your access request [reference, illustrative]
Paragraph 1: confirm the request date and scope agreed.
Paragraph 2: describe what is provided and the time period covered.
Paragraph 3: note any items withheld and the basis, as advised by counsel.
Paragraph 4: explain how to ask follow-up questions.
sections.heading: Access fulfilled letter

body: Subject: Confirmation of deletion [reference, illustrative]
Paragraph 1: confirm the request and scope of deletion.
Paragraph 2: list sources addressed at a general level and completion dates (illustrative).
Paragraph 3: note lawful retention exceptions, if any, as advised by counsel.
Paragraph 4: state backup and log handling in plain terms from the runbook.
sections.heading: Deletion confirmed letter

body: Subject: Outcome of your request [reference, illustrative]
Paragraph 1: acknowledge the request and review performed.
Paragraph 2: state the specific basis for declining fully or partly, as advised by counsel.
Paragraph 3: explain available next steps or appeal channel.
Do not use this letter without counsel review of the basis in the specific matter.

fields: Basis relied on per counsel advice:

sections.heading: Rejection with basis letter

body: Subject: Extension notice for your request [reference, illustrative]
Paragraph 1: reference the original request and statutory clock that applies per counsel advice.
Paragraph 2: explain why added time is needed in plain terms.
Paragraph 3: give the new expected response date (illustrative) and a contact.
Send before the original deadline passes where the applicable law permits extensions.
sections.heading: Extension notice letter
